transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I've called us together to finalize the operating plan for the one-night audience-participation recreation of our featured film scene. As you all know, the experience involves a movable scenic set, guided participant groups, and a marked route through the event space. I'm responsible for giving the final authorization on the operating plan, but before I can sign off, I need each technical and compliance lead to go through the formal finding-report step and place any final findings into the shared record. Once those findings are in, I'll record any resulting documentation or follow-up work as commitments — and to be clear, those commitments don't all need to be completed during this meeting for me to authorize. So let's work through this systematically. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a critical finding from this morning's vendor load test. I confirmed that the planned 900 kg scenic unit cannot be moved through the event space safely. The certified alternative is two separate 300 kg carts. I have not yet entered this result in the operating plan, so I'm placing it into the shared record now through this formal finding-report step.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical compliance finding to place into the shared record. I confirmed with the festival's insurer this afternoon that our coverage applies only when participant groups contain no more than 8 people and every participant signs the approved waiver. The written confirmation is still pending in my compliance inbox, but this is a binding condition for our coverage. The operating plan must reflect these two requirements: maximum group size of 8 and signed waivers from every participant.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Enter the scenic unit finding and 300 kg cart alternative into the formal operating plan record
Obtain and file the written insurance confirmation from the compliance inbox
Ensure the operating plan reflects the maximum group size of 8 and signed waiver requirement
